class.name: WebSelect
class.brief_description: HTML-like select control with customizable select styling slots.
class.description: [WebSelect] is a form-style select control modeled after HTML's [code]<select>[/code] element. It supports single selection, multiple selection, listbox sizing, disabled items, separators, option groups, item values, and theme items corresponding to CSS customizable select parts such as the closed select button, picker, picker icon, selected option checkmark, and option states.

method.name: add_icon_item
method.description: Adds an item with an icon, display text, submitted value, and optional ID. If [param value] is empty, the item value falls back to [param text] unless changed later with [method set_item_value].

method.name: add_item
method.description: Adds an item with display text, submitted value, and optional ID. If [param value] is empty, the item value falls back to [param text] unless changed later with [method set_item_value].

method.name: add_optgroup
method.description: Adds a non-selectable option group label.

method.name: deselect
method.description: Deselects an item when [member multiple] is enabled.

method.name: get_selected
method.description: Returns the primary selected item index, or [code]-1[/code].

method.name: get_style_metrics
method.description: Returns structured geometry, value, and theme metrics for automated browser parity tests.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns whether the control satisfies its required value constraint.

method.name: show_picker
method.description: Shows the popup picker for dropdown mode.
